title: pvSurfaceTangents
body:
## pvSurfaceTangents

Computes per-point tangent vectors (array Tangents) of a triangulated surface from its point normals and texture coordinates, as required for normal-map texturing in rendering. The input must be triangle polydata with point Normals and texture coordinates; the output is the same polydata with tangents added. Use it only for textured rendering; it has no analysis meaning.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Missing normals or texture coordinates make the filter fail; run normals and a texture-mapping step (e.g. pvTextureMaptoPlane) first, and triangulate general polygons.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SurfaceTangents`. Identity: `filters/SurfaceTangents`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Tangents Generation filter. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeCellTangents` | This filter computes the tangents at the points in the data set. In the process of doing this it computes polygon tangents too. If you want these normals to be passed to the output of this filter, set the value of this property to 1. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSurfaceTangents",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
